title: Fresh Strawberry Sorbet
changes_from_base: Raw strawberries blended with sugar, corn syrup, lemon and a pinch of salt instead of mango, lime and a cooked syrup; chilled 6 h and frozen in a loaf tin.
summary: Raw ripe strawberries blended with sugar, corn syrup and a squeeze of lemon, chilled and churned into a deep red, fresh-tasting sorbet.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the quartered strawberries, sugar, corn syrup, lemon juice and salt for about 1 min until completely smooth. Taste: add a little more lemon if the flavour seems flat.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 h, until 4 °C or colder. Put the loaf tin in the freezer.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 15-25 min until thick like soft serve.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Scrape into the cold tin, pressing out any air pockets, lay baking paper on the surface and freeze for at least 6 h.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Leave for 5-10 min to soften, then scoop into bowls and add a halved strawberry to each.

tips: Use the reddest, ripest strawberries for the deepest colour.
Sieve out the seeds after blending if you want a silkier sorbet.
The salt is tiny but sharpens the fruit flavour.
storage: Keep frozen and covered for up to 1 week.
